entries.zh: 溝；水沟、沟渠
entries.en: 溝: ditch; water channel
entries.notes: M 栏封存为「caú chùy」，其中第二音节与 H 栏的对应关系未定。

entries.zh: 管；水管、筒管（导水之管筒）
entries.en: pipe; tube, conduit (for water)

entries.zh: 鴨嘴；左栏指 chirimía 管乐器的管，具体部位存疑
entries.en: 鴨嘴: the left column refers to a pipe of a chirimía (shawm); the exact part is uncertain
entries.notes: H 栏为「鴨嘴」，L 栏为「caño de chirimiã.」；是否特指吹嘴未定。

entries.zh: 溝〔窪/窑存疑〕；水沟、沟渠，具体词义及对应关系未定
entries.en: 溝〔窪/窑 uncertain〕: a water channel or ditch; the exact sense and correspondence are uncertain
entries.notes: H 栏封存为「溝窪 [疑:窪/窑]」；L 栏为「caño de agua zanja」，M 栏为「caú cūi」、R 栏为「quén cūi」。不凭音写确定第二字。

entries.zh: 溝壑；沟谷、沟槽；左栏为水道或水管，具体对应关系待核
entries.en: 溝壑: ditch or gully; the left column refers to a water conduit, and the precise correspondence remains uncertain
entries.notes: H 栏为「溝壑」，L 栏为「caño de agua.」；未据此确定沟的大小。

entries.zh: 酒筩；蒸馏酒用的管
entries.en: 酒筩: pipe for distilling wine
entries.notes: L 栏为「caño para destilar el bino」；管的材质未注明。

entries.zh: 圳溝；水沟、沟渠；左栏末词的含义未定
entries.en: 圳溝: water channel or ditch; the meaning of the final word in the left column remains uncertain
entries.notes: L 栏末词为「rayadera」，其含义及与本条的关系未定。

entries.zh: 左栏为 Cañon，另有 pluma（羽毛或笔）；具体词义及缩写存疑
entries.en: The left column has Cañon and pluma (feather or pen); the exact sense and abbreviation are uncertain
entries.notes: L 栏为「Cañon. q. pluma.」；H、M、R 栏均为「[空]」。缩写「q.」未作展开。

entries.zh: 劳；劳累；左栏也有使人疲劳之义
entries.en: 劳: to toil or grow tired; the left column also has the sense “to tire or weary”
entries.notes: M 栏封存为「bōa lô」，其两个音节与 H 栏单字「劳」的对应关系未定。

entries.zh: 劳烦；使人疲劳或烦扰
entries.en: to tire, weary or annoy

entries.zh: 惰；懒惰、倦怠；左栏也有疲倦之义
entries.en: 惰: lazy or indolent; the left column also includes tiredness

entries.zh: 倦；因某种劳作而疲倦
entries.en: 倦: tired or weary from some work
entries.notes: L 栏末词「yngucio」未解，未据此断定劳作的性质。

entries.zh: 厌；厌倦、厌烦（对某事生厌）
entries.en: tired of, weary of something; annoyed

entries.zh: 劳；劳累，也可指使人疲劳
entries.en: 劳: to toil or grow tired; to tire or weary

entries.zh: 餒〔疑餒/餓〕；疲倦、饥饿，字形及词义对应存疑
entries.en: 餒〔餒/餓 uncertain〕: tired; hungry. The character and its exact correspondence are uncertain.
entries.notes: H 栏封存为「餒 [疑:餒/餓]」，M 栏为「luè」、R 栏为「múi」；L 栏为「cansado hambriento.」。不凭音写定字。

entries.zh: 困；困乏、疲惫不堪（力竭）
entries.en: exhausted, worn out; overcome with fatigue
entries.notes: M 栏第三音节及 R 栏的音调标记为 T99；M 栏封存「cêñ cūn tūn」，与 H 栏「困」的对应关系未定。释义据 H 栏及 L 栏「cansado, rendido」给出。

entries.zh: 屑〔疑屑/厭〕；左栏为疲劳、疲倦，汉字词义及对应关系存疑
entries.en: 屑〔屑/厭 uncertain〕: the left column means fatigue or weariness; the character’s sense and correspondence are uncertain
entries.notes: H 栏封存为「屑 [疑:屑/厭]」，M 栏为「hiânşiag」、R 栏为「şîōg」；不凭音写定字。

entries.zh: 着劳；疲倦、烦倦；左栏也有使人疲倦、烦恼之义
entries.en: 着劳: weary; annoyed. The left column also gives the senses “to tire and annoy”.
entries.notes: L 栏另有「o cansar y enfadar」，动词义与 H 栏的具体对应关系未定。

entries.zh: 脚酸；疲倦，脚酸痛
entries.en: 脚酸: tired, with sore or aching feet

entries.zh: 劳心；心神劳倦、费神；左栏含 imaginaciones（想象、思绪），全句意思未定
entries.en: 劳心: mental weariness; the left column mentions imaginaciones (imaginings or thoughts), but the full phrase is unclear
entries.notes: L 栏为「cansado y de imaginaciones」，其句法及细义未定。

entries.zh: 劳力；气力疲乏、体力疲倦
entries.en: 劳力: weariness or fatigue of physical strength

entries.zh: 劳倦；因劳作而困倦
entries.en: weary from work; fatigued by labor
